purpose: Canonical register of verified public credibility associations and pending claims for STL Automate.
publishing_rule: Use only active entries, preserve approved phrasing and scope, and verify logo or mark rights before use.

entries.exact_relationship: STL Automate's internal production automation runs on self-hosted n8n. This documents internal technology use, not an n8n partnership or customer deployment.
evidence/reference: src/app/(site)/tech/page.js: Workflow Orchestration section states internal production automation runs on self-hosted n8n.
AGENTS.md: n8n is identified as STL Automate's automation engine.
allowed_phrasing: STL Automate's internal production automation runs on self-hosted n8n.
STL Automate uses self-hosted n8n for its internal production automation.
prohibited_implications: n8n endorses, sponsors, invests in, or partners with STL Automate.
All customer deployments use n8n or are hosted by STL Automate.
entries.logo_usage_status: Not verified; do not use n8n logo or marks until rights are checked.
entries.notes: Keep the statement scoped to internal production automation.

allowed_phrasing: HubSpot is STL Automate's CRM source of truth.
Agent Floor Customer Zero V2 completed one governed HubSpot write with durable evidence.
STL Automate has validated a governed HubSpot write in Agent Floor Customer Zero V2.
prohibited_implications: HubSpot endorses, sponsors, invests in, or partners with STL Automate.

entries.exact_relationship: STL Automate has been approved for AWS Activate.
evidence/reference: User confirmation in the current task: 'we've been approved'. The August 24, 2026 AWS for Startups welcome email documents access to AWS for Startups offerings; separate evidence of an AWS Activate Credits award was not provided.

evidence_metadata.subject: Welcome to AWS for Startups!
quoted_evidence: Welcome to AWS for Startups! You now have access to programs and offerings designed to help you build, grow, and scale on AWS.
Apply to receive up to $200,000 in Activate Credits...
evidence_metadata.qualification: Approval for AWS Activate is confirmed by the user. The welcome email's offer to apply for up to $200,000 in credits is not evidence that any specific credits were awarded.

allowed_phrasing: STL Automate participates in AWS Activate.
Building with support/resources available through AWS Activate.
prohibited_implications: AWS as a customer, investor, or client
any specific AWS Activate Credits awarded amount unless separately evidenced

entries.notes: Approval supports stating that STL Automate is approved for/participates in AWS Activate. Do not imply an AWS partnership, backing, endorsement, sponsorship, customer/investor/client relationship, or a specific credits award. Keep logo/mark rights separate and unverified.
